Some years ago a preacher of whom we have some knowledge had delivered his message to an ordinary congregation, aud at the close asked any awakened person present to rise up. One man responded, and when the preacher went to him he was surprised and a little puzzled to hear him say that he had accepted Christ and found peace during the sermon. The story bore every mark of truthfulness, but the preacher had never before met with a similar case. He determined to watch closely and see what came of it, but very soon other similar cases occurred, and he waa astonished at his own spiritual dulness in not having seen long before that this was God's plan, God's ordinary method, of saving sinners.

Some ten days ago the men employed in the weaving department submitted a petition to the manager asking for an increase of salary which was granted to them, and the employees of the spinning department took objection to this and struck. This happened on last Thursday, and yesterday the strikers attacked the weavers as they were going to work.
